newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma, fixed-coupon bonds firmer, depos flat.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma, fixed-coupon bonds firmer, depos flat.

text.p: Greek depos were steady, forex forwards were marginally higher in short tenors, fixed coupon bonds were firmer and ecu/drachma was trading higher, piercing the 310 level, dealers said.
"Depos are steady and bids of forex forwards are marginally up," said a trader at a private bank. "I do not see something in the near future that could change rates drastically."
Bank of Greece offered to soak up to 200 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent on Wednesday.

Fixed coupon bonds were well bid banking on a lower inflation figure in April, expectations of lower rates, a calm forex scene and a reduced supply of three-year fixed coupon bonds in the rest of the year, dealers said.

National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told reporters on Tuesday that inflation fell below 6.0 percent year-on-year in April. The chairman of his economic advisors told Reuters that CPI inflation would settle at 5.8 or 5.9 percent in April.

But other bond dealers said the bond market should correct at some point with the deceleration of inflation slowing down in the next few months and public finances not showing the improvement envisaged by the government.

"There is a technical factor that has kept bond prices at these high levels and this is the unwillingness of some banks to take profits because they will be forced to mark their bond portfolios to the market at lower prices," said a bond trader at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 158.91/96 from Tuesday's 158.830 fix, the dollar at 273.90/00 drachmas from 274.590 and the ecu at 310.09/19 from 309.750 drachmas.

"Ecu/drachma is firmer trading above 310 but trading volume is thin," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "I expect ecu/drachma to range between 309.50 and 310.50 for some time with 310.20/30 being weak resistance."
